renewal.continued.discount: Your discount save applies from {from} until {to}, exclusive.
renewal.continued.pause: Your pause save applies from {from} until {to}, exclusive.
renewal.continued.tail: Renewal remains enabled. No further step is needed.

renewal.cancelled.title: Renewal cancelled

renewal.manage.title: Manage renewal
renewal.manage.heading: Manage your renewal
renewal.manage.renews: It renews automatically unless you cancel.
renewal.manage.uplift: Renewal price uplift: {percent}%. Billing remains monthly. Your renewal email lists the charges.
renewal.manage.no_steps: No sign-in, call, chat, reason or save offer is required. Access continues until the term ends.
renewal.save.discount: {percent}% off fixed and seat charges for {months} monthly periods
renewal.save.from: From {from}; existing item end dates stay in place.
renewal.notice.subject: Subscription renewal on {date}
renewal.notice.renews: Your subscription renews on {date} through {end}. Renewal uplift: {percent}%.
renewal.notice.cancel: Cancel renewal online with one confirmation, no sign-in or call: {link}
return.unavailable.title: Offer unavailable
return.unavailable.heading: This return offer is no longer available
return.unavailable.body: It may have expired or already been used. Contact the business for your subscription status.
return.resumed.title: Subscription resumed
return.resumed.body: Your service resumes {day}. {percent}% off fixed and seat charges applies for monthly periods from {from} until {to}, exclusive. Usage is billed at its ordinary rate. No further step is required.
return.changed.heading: The subscription changed
return.changed.body: Ask the business for a fresh offer. No change was applied.
return.offer.title: Your return offer
return.offer.body: Resume this subscription with {percent}% off fixed and seat charges for {months} monthly periods, including the current open period. Usage is excluded. The discount ends automatically.
return.offer.expires: Expires {date}. Your service resumes when you accept; inactive days are not billed.
winback.subject: Your subscription return offer
winback.body: Return to your subscription with {percent}% off fixed and seat charges for {months} monthly billing periods. Usage is excluded. Offer expires {date} in {zone}. Accept once: {link}
certificate.subject: {state} exemption certificate {status}
certificate.body: {name}: your {state} exemption certificate is {status}. Please send a current certificate to {address}. Billing cannot use an exemption without validated coverage for the service period.
certificate.body.dated: {name}: your {state} exemption certificate is {status} (expires {date}). Please send a current certificate to {address}. Billing cannot use an exemption without validated coverage for the service period.
correction.subject: Billing correction and draft invoice explanation
correction.intro: This billing correction changes the draft calculations shown below.
correction.next: Next affected invoice service period: {from} to {to} (end exclusive).
correction.engine: These are exact invoice-engine calculations from the recorded inputs. Preparing this explanation does not issue an invoice; invoice approval and issue remain separate.
correction.term.open: {term}; effective {from}, with no recorded end date.
erasure.mail.subject: Confirm your personal-data erasure request
erasure.mail.body:
Someone recorded a personal-data erasure request. Confirm only if you requested it. This link expires in seven days. Confirmation does not erase records; the owner must approve it.
{link}
erasure.confirm.title: Confirm erasure request
erasure.confirm.body: Confirm that you requested personal-data erasure. The owner must approve it before records change. Minimal financial documents remain for seven years.
erasure.unavailable: This confirmation link is no longer available
erasure.verified: Request verified. The owner can now review it.
correction.revenue.heading: Revenue schedule effect
correction.revenue.credit: The credit records {amount} of contra-revenue in the month beginning {from}; original line schedules and tax stay unchanged.
correction.revenue.schedule: Line {line} recognizes {amount} in the month beginning {from} under {policy}.
portal.heading: Billing overview
portal.readonly: View your billing records and prepaid authorizations. Contact the business for other billing changes or payments.
portal.unavailable.body: Ask the business for a new billing session.
portal.privacy.heading: Privacy request
portal.privacy.pending: Request recorded. Verification is still required.
portal.privacy.mail.accepted: The email provider accepted the confirmation message. Inbox delivery is not confirmed.
portal.privacy.mail.rejected: The email provider rejected the confirmation message. Contact the business to verify your request.
portal.privacy.mail.rate_limited: The email provider could not accept the confirmation message because of its sending limit. Contact the business to verify your request.
portal.privacy.mail.uncertain: The confirmation message outcome is unknown. Contact the business to verify your request.
portal.privacy.mail.suppressed: This local installation does not send email. Contact the business to verify your request.
portal.privacy.mail.not_configured: Confirmation email is not configured. Contact the business to verify your request.
portal.answer.heading: Billing answers
portal.answer.question: Question
portal.answer.saved: These figures come from saved billing records. Reading this answer changes no records. Contact the business to request an adjustment.
portal.answer.pending: A request prepares a pending proposal for human review. No credit or customer message is issued here.
portal.answer.credit.explanation: A requested credit of {amount} would reduce the recorded balance from {before} to {after}. This proposal requires human review and does not establish that the bill was incorrect. Original invoice tax remains unchanged.
portal.answer.credit.subject: Proposed credit for invoice {invoice}
portal.upcoming.heading: Usage and upcoming invoice
portal.upcoming.excludes: This uses recorded inputs. Future usage is not predicted; issuing and payment require the business’s ordinary billing process.
portal.adjustments.heading: Approved billing adjustments
portal.adjustments.approved: Approved by the business. The message below is the wording retained with that decision; it does not confirm inbox delivery.
portal.request.unavailable.body: Check the selected invoice and question, or contact the business.
usageCorrection.subject: Historical usage correction
usageCorrection.period: {number} ({from} to {to}): subtotal change {subtotal}; tax change {tax}; total change {total}. Source: {source}. Replay: {fingerprint}. Revenue postings: {revenue}.
usageCorrection.footer: Policy: {policy}. Negative corrections are numbered credit notes. Next-invoice credits are carried to later invoices; other credits offset the unpaid original, carrying any excess. No cash refund or negative invoice is created. Positive differences bill next period or on a separate correcting invoice. Original event IDs and revenue details: {receipt}.
renewal.save.discount_periods: {percent}% off the selected fixed or seat price for {months} invoice periods
return.offer.body_periods: Resume this subscription with {percent}% off the selected fixed or seat price for {months} invoice periods, including the current unissued period. Usage is excluded. The discount ends automatically.
winback.body_periods: Return to your subscription with {percent}% off the selected fixed or seat price for {months} invoice periods. Usage is excluded. Offer expires {date} in {zone}. Accept once: {link}
usageCorrection.prepaid: Prepaid {kind}: {quantity} on {date}; contract liability {liability}; recognized revenue {revenue}. Source: {source}
portal.prepaid.heading: Prepaid credits
portal.prepaid.asOf: Recorded as of {date}. Refresh to read the latest recorded balance.
portal.topup.heading: Automatic prepaid top-ups
portal.topup.terms: When your available balance reaches {threshold} or below, purchase {quantity} for {amount}. The maximum is {cap} per calendar month in {zone}, including payments with an unknown outcome.
portal.topup.dates: Charges may run from {start} until {end} (end exclusive).
portal.topup.expiry: New credit starts on the captured payment date and expires {expiry}.
portal.topup.priority: Drawdown priority {priority}. Rollover: {percent}% for {months} months; rollover cap {cap}.
portal.topup.revocation: You can revoke here before another charge is claimed. Card replacement ends this authorization. A payment already claimed may still complete; an unknown result is never automatically retried.
portal.topup.accept: I authorize off-session card charges of {amount} under these exact terms, up to {cap} per business calendar month.
portal.topup.status.pending: Your acceptance is recorded; business approval is pending
correction.revenue.prepaidCredit: The credit reduces unpaid prepaid contract liability by {amount} in the month beginning {from}; recognized revenue, original line schedules and tax stay unchanged.
refund.notice.refunded.subject: Refund for purchase {purchase}
refund.notice.refunded.body: Your unused paid credit refund is confirmed. Refunded amount: {amount}. Unused credit: {units}. Original purchase: {purchase}. Numbered credit: {credit}.
refund.notice.failed.subject: Refund failed for purchase {purchase}
refund.notice.failed.body: Your unused paid credit refund failed. Requested amount: {amount}. Unused credit: {units}. Original purchase: {purchase}. Credit: {credit}. No cash refund was confirmed.
portal.refund.heading: Request unused paid credit refund
portal.refund.pending: Refund request pending financial review. No money has moved.
portal.refund.body: A finance member reviews the current unused balance and a different member approves any return to the original card.
portal.commitment.heading: Minimum commitment
portal.commitment.basis: Before tax. One-time fees and fixed credits do not reduce this minimum. Approved usage corrections are shown separately from the original issued amounts.
portal.quota.heading: Current usage quotas
checkout.heading: Payment methods
checkout.explain: Enter your payment details only on Stripe. Saving a default method does not authorize a charge.
checkout.mandate: An active ACH mandate was verified with Stripe.
checkout.consent: I want to save a payment method through Stripe.
checkout.default: Make the verified payment method my default. This does not authorize a charge.
checkout.empty: No payment method setup is ready. Contact the business.
checkout.status.prepared: Ready to enter payment details securely.
checkout.status.creating: Checkout creation is awaiting confirmation. Contact the business; do not start again.
checkout.status.open: Complete Stripe checkout, then verify your saved method here.
checkout.status.updating: Default method confirmation is pending. Contact the business; do not repeat.
checkout.status.complete: Your payment method was saved. Your separate default choice was applied.
checkout.verify: Check the original Stripe setup. This does not authorize a charge.
checkout.historical: Historical setup only. A new setup and consent are required before use.
checkout.choice.selected: You chose to make this the default method.
checkout.choice.unchanged: Your previous default method is unchanged.
checkout.mandate.unavailable: The authorization wording is unavailable here. Saving this account does not permit Nectar to debit it.
checkout.status.failed: The original checkout expired without a usable setup. Contact the business for a newly prepared setup.
automatic.heading: Authorize this invoice payment
automatic.consent: I authorize {merchant} to collect {amount} once on {date} for this invoice, using my {method} ending {last4}. This does not authorize retries, other invoices or future charges. I can withdraw before the attempt.
automatic.accept: I accept this exact one-time collection.
automatic.invalidated: Terms changed; a new authorization is required
paymentLink.heading: Subscription signup
paymentLink.terms: These are full-month prices before any promotion. Your first invoice uses the subscription's service dates and trial; it may be prorated. Tax follows the reviewed policy shown here. Future invoices are billed by Nectar. Any automatic card collection requires separate authorization and approval.
paymentLink.save: I accept these subscription terms and want Stripe to save my card. No charge is made now.
paymentLink.default: Also make this saved card my default payment method. This does not authorize a debit.
paymentLink.noDebit: Saving a card and starting this subscription do not authorize an automatic charge. Trial collection requires separate approval.
paymentLink.name: Name
paymentLink.promotion: Promotion {code}: {value} off, {duration}, on {products}. The invoice applies the native coupon rules.
paymentLink.unavailableBody: Contact the business if you need help. If you already started, keep your original return page; do not begin another checkout while its outcome is unknown.
paymentLink.taxPolicy: Reviewed tax policy: {jurisdiction}; declared rate {rate}% on taxable items.
paymentLink.oneTime.heading: One-time payment
paymentLink.oneTime.terms: You authorize one card payment for the exact total shown, including the declared tax. Stripe processes the payment and Nectar records a numbered invoice and receipt. Your card is not saved as a default and this does not authorize future charges.
paymentLink.oneTime.pay: I accept these terms and authorize this exact one-time total through Stripe.
paymentLink.oneTime.noRecurring: This is one payment only. No subscription or future automatic charge is authorized.
paymentLink.renews: Renews for {months} months with {percent}% uplift; notice {days} days before. Online cancellation takes one confirmation.
paymentLink.ends: Ends after {months} months. No automatic renewal or renewal uplift.
automatic.returned: ACH payment returned; invoice remains owed
paymentLink.oneTime.recording: Your payment was captured; the invoice is being prepared. Do not pay again.
automatic.historical: Historical terms; no new debit is authorized
methods.confirm.default: Use this method as my default. This does not authorize a charge.
methods.confirm.remove: Remove this saved method from the processor.
methods.status.uncertain: The processor outcome is unconfirmed. Reconcile the original request without repeating it.
methods.status.complete: Your payment method choice is complete.
methods.status.superseded: A newer prepared choice replaced this request.
cardExpiry.subject: {merchant}: update your card before renewal
cardExpiry.body: {merchant}: your card ending in {last4} expires {expiry}, before your renewal on {renewal}.
automatic.retryConsent: I authorize up to {count} total payment attempts within {days} days of the first failure on this same method for this invoice, using retry table {version}. No retry notices are sent.
automatic.retryInitialConsent: I authorize {merchant} to collect {amount} on {date} for this invoice using my {method} ending {last4}, with the bounded attempts described below. No other invoice or amount is authorized. I may withdraw future attempts after a definitive failure.
automatic.retryAccept: I accept this exact invoice and its bounded payment attempts.
retry.recovery.heading: Retry with another card
retry.recovery.accept: I authorize this single attempt with the new card.
retry.recovery.consent: I authorize {merchant} to collect {amount} for invoice {invoice} once using the new card ending in {last4}. This replaces the card from the refused attempt and does not authorize further attempts.
retry.authentication.heading: Confirm the existing card
retry.authentication.accept: I authorize one authentication attempt with this card.
retry.authentication.consent: I authorize {merchant} to collect {amount} for invoice {invoice} once using the existing card ending in {last4}, after I confirm with my bank. This does not authorize automatic retries or other invoices.
